requirement.description: The model evaluation harness is broken and does not run. The evaluation harness exists but has stopped working.
requirement.fact: The model evaluation harness is broken and does not run.
requirement.reading: The evaluation harness exists but has stopped working.

narrator.name: Model Monica
narrator.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something exists but is broken: it used to work, or someone started it, and it stopped or stalled. Describe the workaround people use today because it does not work, never that it does not exist. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: The evaluation harness for the forecast model has not completed a run since the feature schema changed in July. It starts, loads the test weeks, and then fails on a missing column before any scores are written. Each new model version is checked by hand instead: I export the predictions for the last six weeks, join them with the actual sales in a notebook, and compute the error per product group. The results go into a shared sheet next to the previous version's numbers. Two retrained versions have gone through this route so far this summer. The harness code is still in the repository, unchanged since its last successful run.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes the current operational state of the evaluation harness and the manual workaround being used, without expressing any wishes, refusals, or stated trade-offs.
